items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: There are times when you have super sidemen like ... Mario Rivera ... you always found somebody to fit in with your band.

ctx.x: Well, I always considered that a change is always, most of the time, for the best; and they was young musicians, very enthusiastic and with good qualifications and not just that it just was good qualifications, they listened to us. They listened to us about what we want and they was flexible enough to play close to what we want, so we was happy, really.

Okay. There are times when you have super sidemen like Chocolaté Armenteros, Jose Chombo Silva, Mario Rivera, Mauricio Smith, and I've heard the band when you didn't have them. They didn't sound as good, but it sounded very good, so you've proven one thing to me, that you always found somebody to fit in with your band. How are you able to do this?

Well, I, is a matter of experience, not that I know all the answers, but I know my music very well and the music is the arrangement that's top-flight because they are made by top-flight arrangers, so when everything is written right and you just read close to what is written, got the sound good.
